puzzle-solving within its inherited framework. The framework dictates both what counts as a solution and what counts as a problem. A cross-cutting explanation is essentially a paradigm shift\u2014a re-conceptualization that crosses lineage boundaries. By allocating problems to the lineage that produced the parent, the system ensures that problems are always addressed as 'normal science' for that lineage. The lineage will work diligently on the problem, but it will only produce solutions that are legible within its own paradigm.
